fields.rationale: 2024-25 average base salary gender pay gap for the employer reporting unit; stored as a decimal fraction per the publisher convention. The 2023-24 comparison column is a separate header and is not consumed here. No date column exists in the source, so the reporting year is carried as a literal period qualifier rather than a claim_period. Explicit trim/null_if/parse_decimal steps make the decimal-fraction strings (including '0') parse as decimals without multiplication or whole-percentage relabelling.

2024-25 average total remuneration gender pay gap for the employer reporting unit; total remuneration is pay, not business income. The duplicate-labelled 2023-24 column is disambiguated by year group and not consumed. No date column exists, so the year is a literal period qualifier. Explicit trim/null_if/parse_decimal steps accept the publisher's decimal-fraction strings as decimals.

2024-25 median base salary gender pay gap for the employer reporting unit; decimal-fraction storage convention preserved, with '0' treated as a legitimate zero gap rather than missing. No date column exists, so the year is a literal period qualifier. Explicit trim/null_if/parse_decimal steps make the decimal-fraction strings parse as decimals.
